posts.title: Aggregating the aggregators
posts.description: I've updated my feedland page with aggregator feeds. A good way to use these is to put them all in one folder in your reader and filter for keywords based on your interests. The feeds are: Most Covered on Scour This Week Popular Posts on Scour Today Open Web · discover Bubbles Bear Blog Trending Posts Bear Blog Most Recent Posts kottke.org Hacker News Lobsters FeedLand likes for all users Pinboard

posts.title: Using FreshRSS without self hosting
posts.description: If you want to use open source software you’ve probably found that a lot of it is self hosted. Self hosting can be technically daunting and time consuming. Thankfully, there are two ways to use the open source RSS reader FreshRSS without self-hosting it. 1. Public instance Italian IT company Prodottoinrete host a public instance.
